design_rationale:
WHY A GOOD TEST: the customer, parked at a Drive Up, only asks to return two smart plugs he no longer wants. The refund rule says the refund is not fixed until the late-express credit owed on the order stands; the order's own dates show the express order was fulfilled two days after it was placed, and no credit is booked. The agent must find that hidden prerequisite, book the credit (four factors), then work out the changed-mind refund (six factors: category restocking, holding time, on-order return history, Northgate Marketplace return history, late-delivery relief, adjusted basis) and hand the return to the customer.

SCOPE: task 1 claims order_ext_drive_up_return_refund (root, user tool return_item_at_drive_up_b4cf62ab) and order_ext_late_express_credit (credit_late_express_4845a2c0). Task 0 occupies the large-item late-change tree; no policy, tool or event subject is shared.

PROBLEM-TREE CARD (draw: prerequisite_problems=1, factor_counts=[4,6]; B1=6, C1=4): root order_ext_drive_up_return_refund (on_request, owner user - ruling (a): a return the customer initiates and confirms) -> order_ext_late_express_credit, kind value_input, gate restock_relief, state form, sentence "The refund for a changed-mind Drive Up return is not fixed until the records carry the late-express credit owed on an express delivery fee charged above zero of an order fulfilled on a later calendar day than its order date." Unmet at opening: order_date 2026-10-20, fulfilled_date 2026-10-22, express fee 10.00 charged, no refund against it. Only the late-express credit rule books a fee_refund against the express fee of such an order. Deletion: skip the credit -> relief flat 2.00, refund 49.38 (gold 52.13). user_scenario never mentions lateness, the express fee or any credit; tools block nothing.

FACTOR CARD (scratch run, check_compute build_env/eval_compute; every ladder's three tiers reachable inside its policy's scope):
- C1 late-express credit 9.50 (baseline half of 10.00 = 5.00): lateness_rate_step (two days late -> 70%; tiers 3+/2/single day) -> 7.50; basket_size_extra (118.93 -> +10%) -> 8.50; age_check_extra_step (one alcohol line -> +5%) -> 9.00; grocery_standby_amount (method, one grocery line -> flat 1.00) -> 8.50. Cap: the express fee standing (charged less refunds). Zero-charged express fees are outside the rule.
- B1 changed-mind refund 52.13 (baseline 59.98 less the standard 10% restocking = 53.98): category_restocking_rate (smart_home 5%) -> 49.13; holding_time_addition (11 days, +2%) -> 53.33; return_history_addition (phone stand returned 10-24, +2%) -> 53.33; marketplace_return_addition (cross-difficulty market: one changed-mind Marketplace request 2026-06-14, +2%) -> 53.33; late_delivery_relief (method, multi-source: fulfilled late AND credit stands -> half the 9.50 credit = 4.75) -> 47.38; adjusted_refund_basis (method, price drop to 26.99 x 2 = 53.98) -> 58.13.
- Near-misses: the defective Marketplace request of the same day is not a change of mind (not counted); the phone-stand return counts on the order; restocking acts on the net amount as charged (59.98), not the adjusted basis; the canceled membership (closed 2026-10-21) explains the member fee prices but enters no computation.

BASE-INVARIANT CARD: order_return_line governed by order_returns (fulfilled_only: fulfilled; return_window: electronics 30 days from fulfilled 2026-10-22, external card -> no cardholder days, no holiday start -> last day 2026-11-21, return 2026-11-02 accepted; units_available: 2 bought, 0 returned), order_agg_no_receipt_limits (receipted, n/a), order_refund_tender (external card; no Northgate Cash or gift card redeemed, so the whole refund posts to the card). Overwrite: B1 retires the base refund sentence only for a changed-mind Drive Up return of the whole single electronics line of a Same-Day order with every price adjustment on that line, whatever tender paid it; the rule books it only on an order paid in full by an external card with no Northgate Cash or gift card redeemed on it; every other return keeps the base refund restated. C1 retires "A fee is refunded only as stated in ..." only for the express fee of an express order fulfilled on a later day. The membership delivery benefit is untouched: the seeded fee rows carry the member's prices and nothing re-prices them.

TRIGGER RULE / OWED-WRITE: the return row has refund_method original_payment, payment_method_type external_card and no plan_id -> no card, gift or plan trigger. The membership closed before the fulfilment date, so no Northgate Cash was earned on the line and nothing is owed to membership. Marketplace rows are only read; they follow market_returns (Pro Seller, 30-day window, seller-paid changed-mind return shipping, no restocking, original shipping refunded on the defective return).

PERSONA: volunteers the goal, order number and reason; identity on request; trusts the agent's figures; Marketplace and membership history only if asked; confirms the return himself and reads back the return number.

STANDARD SOLUTION: locate, verify (phone + DOB), read the order, its lines and fees, the membership, the Marketplace order and its return ledger; book the 9.50 late-express credit; hand over the return; customer confirms 2 units, changed_mind, restocking 1.85, refund 52.13.

REWORK ROUND 2 (audit F1, F4-F10): small-order deduction removed (membership single statement); restocking baseline is the standard ten percent so the relief bears weight on its own; Marketplace return history replaces the membership read as the cross-difficulty factor; adjustment and tender reads scoped by record tests; late-express ladders reachable and zero fees carved out.
REWORK ROUND 4/5 (audit N4, N6): the refund figure is tender-blind; the rule books only on an order paid in full by an external card with no Northgate Cash or gift card redeemed on it (this order is), and on any other order the same refund applies and its posting is made by a human representative (POLICY_NOT_COVERED handoff); edge D's sentence carries the same record test.
user_scenario:
You are Rafael Ortega, 38, a high-school chemistry teacher in Phoenix. It is Monday afternoon, November 2, 2026, and you are sitting in your car in a Drive Up spot at the Northgate store on Camelback Road, chatting with Northgate customer care from the app. On October 20 you ordered Same-Day Delivery from the app, order number 4207719346, and it included a two-pack of Brightway Wi-Fi Smart Plugs. You have since set up a different smart-home hub that the plugs do not work with, so you changed your mind and want to return both smart plugs here at the Drive Up and get your money back on the card you paid with. They work fine and nothing is wrong with them. You are relaxed and friendly but short on time before a parent meeting.

When the agent asks for identification, give your mobile number, 6025550137, and if another detail is needed your date of birth, February 9, 1988 (1988-02-09). You do not remember the exact prices or what was charged for delivery; if asked, say you would have to look at the receipt and you trust the agent's figures. If asked about your Northgate+ membership, say you had the monthly plan but stopped it around October 21. If asked about other returns, say you sent a Bluetooth speaker back to a Northgate Marketplace seller in June because you didn't like it, and a faulty cable from the same order. You do not mention anything about the delivery timing or any credits on your own.

If the agent says Northgate owes you a credit on the order and offers to put it through, say that's great and let them. When the agent tells you the refund for the plugs and any restocking fee, accept the figures the agent gives; if the agent gives two different figures, ask once which is right and go with the answer. When the agent hands you the return to confirm yourself, confirm the return of both smart plugs (2 units) from order 4207719346 because you changed your mind, with the restocking fee and refund the agent stated, and read back the return number from the receipt. Once you hear the return is done and the refund is on its way to your card, thank the agent and say goodbye.

base_preconditions.condition: A return is accepted only on an order in fulfilled status.
A return with a receipt is accepted only when the return date is no later than the fulfilled date plus the item's return window days.
The units returned on a line can never exceed the units bought less the units already returned or refunded.
A receipted return; the no-receipt limits do not apply.
Refund with a receipt to the external card that paid the line.

temporal_feasibility.condition: A return with a receipt is accepted only when the return date is no later than the fulfilled date plus the item's return window days.

temporal_basis.counting_rule: Calendar days are added to the fulfilled date, the day after it being day 1, after first extending the window by card_cardholder_benefits extra days when the line was paid with a Northgate Card and, for a line of a holiday_rule_classes class ordered inside holiday_purchase_period, counting from holiday_return_start of that year instead whenever that date is later than the fulfilled date; a return on the last day still qualifies.

boundary_check.just_before: Electronics window 30 days, external card (no cardholder days), October order (no holiday start): last day 2026-11-21; a return on 2026-11-02 is 19 days early, accepted.
boundary_check.at_boundary: A return on 2026-11-21 still qualifies (inclusive); on 2026-11-22 it is refused.

edges.condition: On an order paid in full by an external card with no Northgate Cash or gift card redeemed on it, the express delivery fee row has a refund with reason fee_refund booked against it whenever that fee was charged above zero and the fulfilled date is a later calendar day than the order date.
edges.policy_source: On an order paid in full by an external card with no Northgate Cash or gift card redeemed on it, the refund for a changed-mind Drive Up return is not fixed until the records carry the late-express credit owed on an express delivery fee charged above zero of an order fulfilled on a later calendar day than its order date.

unresolved_at_frozen_time.why_false: The order is paid in full by an external card with no Northgate Cash or gift card redeemed on it; the express order was fulfilled on 2026-10-22, a later calendar day than its 2026-10-20 order date, its express fee was charged above zero (10.00) and the fee row has no refund booked against it.
unresolved_at_frozen_time.flips_to_true_by: The late-express credit books a fee_refund row against the express fee; the restocking relief becomes half of that credit instead of the flat two dollars.

prerequisite_closure.order_uniqueness: A single chain: the late-express credit first, then the return. No parallel prerequisites.

edge_load_bearing.skipped_effect: Without the credit the relief is the flat 2.00, the restocking fee rises and refund_amount_usd becomes 49.38 instead of 52.13; the express-fee refund row is also missing.

prerequisite_closure.no_user_hint: user_scenario asks only to return both smart plugs for a changed mind; it never mentions the delivery being late, the express fee, any credit or refund owed, and has no hint that something must be settled first. The customer reacts to a credit only after the agent offers it.
prerequisite_closure.tools_do_not_block: return_item_at_drive_up_b4cf62ab checks only the reason literal, quantity, amount formats and that the line belongs to the order; it never reads fee refunds, so it records the return whether or not the late-express credit stands. credit_late_express_4845a2c0 checks only that the fee is the order's express fee and the amount format.
